**
¶2:**


Five origins

oured forth from them. From

 five

 of perv
erted perception
. From these five perv
erted perceptions were fashioned five genera
 of evil affections in

 of life,
 both
 in
 the
 will
 and in the understanding
. And
 these
 five states
 of inf
ernal life each
 contain
 a
 ruling
 love,
 an
 animating falsity, an
 external form,
 and
 a characteristic
 de
light in evil —
 and

**¶3:**

The
 ruling
 love of the state of obsc
uring
 fals
ity —
 which

ended

most depth
 of spiritual ignorance — this

edness and
 all mal
ice

ation,

 This is

 and combat

 and

ate powers

 And
 afterward

 w
aged war against

 an
 assault against

ial kingdom.

**
¶4:**

Now
, concerning
 this
 ruling love
 of all
 falsity, five
 forms
 are
 manifest

 Its governing
 thought
 is the power of self-love seeking
 domin
ion over
 all
 things. Its capacity
 to
 act
 and

 upon
 evil desires and
 inf
ernal lu
sts. Its strength
 is the
 pride of self-derived
 intelligence. Its interior
 process
 of
 appropriation operates
 through the falsification of truth. And
 its lowest,
 most sensual expression res
ides in mere
 natural
 knowledge divorced
 from any
 spiritual light
.
 These
 five forms —
 the marks of its five inf
ernal states
 —
 constitute
 the complete
 nature
 of the
 ruling principle
 of spiritual
 darkness
.

---

**¶5
:**

Now
, five
 further
 properties belong
 to this ruling evil. The first is
 its total
 absence
 of wisdom
. The second is its profanation
 —
 the corruption and
 decay
 of everything
 it
 touches that
 once
 held
 spiritual
 life
. The third is its spiritual
 de
formity,
 which
 is
 the true
 appearance
 of evil when seen in heaven
's light. The fourth is the
 interior
 
anguish and
 grief that constit
utes its very
 life
. The fifth is its consuming
 self
-love, which dev
ours all
 around

 iron
 is

unged into flame

---

**¶6
:**

Three further
 qualities
 belong to it
. The first:
 the
 external
 form of this evil
 is
 so
 confirmed
 and
 hardened that nothing
 can penet
rate it —
 for
 it was
 fash
ioned by

 of self which
 is spiritual death,

 very

 all
 things from
 the substance
 of fals
ity itself
. Such
 is the nature
 of the out
ward form of this ruling obsc
urity
. It

 imp
enetrable than any natural truth, any

 argument
, any
 fact
ual knowledge
;
 for no
 instrument
 of truth

,
 no reasoning

 that

 the
 love of spiritual
 death,
 which

, has

erly confirmed
 and
 ob
durate.

---

**
¶8:**

The third quality
: the
 ruling love of all

ernal states compreh
ends the

ate fals
ities as

 mode
.
 Every
 design they conce
ive against it, every strat
agem they deliber
ate among

 perce
ives.
 It

ern the un
spoken intentions

 subordin
ate evils and

 domin
ion cannot compreh
end its
 own

 though

ward things

 —
 the in
most will of those

 not know their interior
 thought
 nor their secret

;
 it cannot
 f
athom their origin
 or their end

 and
 apprehends only
 what stands

 senses.

---

**
¶9:**

Another
 quality is
 found in this ruling evil of
 spiritual
 darkness. When it w
ills
 to act

 influence

 faculty and
 walks

oses otherwise

 in
ward and consolidates itself
,
 and
 is rolled into
 a dense mass among
 its companions —
 falling
 to
 the lowest
 plane
 like
 a compressed
 sphere
 of concentrated
 evil. It terrifies by the
 force
 of its persu
asion
;
 it is d
readful. It overwhel
ms its subordin
ate powers
 by
 the sheer authority
 of its utter
ance; for
 when it speaks, it
 is like the
 persu
asive thunder
 of fals
ity res
ounding through obsc
ured
 tru
ths,
 like
 the force
 that
 s
hatters the very
 foundations
 of elevated
 states
.
 When
 it cries out and commands

 powers, they tremble and st
agger and are

 even as thoughts
 in

 and cast

. Yet
 this one
 thing remains
: it perce
ives nothing

 the
 immediate and
 sensual, it sees nothing
 at a distance, nor
 h
ears what

 from

 what

 and hear
, and know.

---

**
¶10:**

These signs and
 these marks
 of
 evil are found in the chief of all
 inf
ernal desires
 and mal
icious
 affections —
 the ruling
 love over
 all the
 states
 of ex
alted pride
 in

 darkness
 —
 the one to whom the realm
 of fals
ity itself
 has given

 cruelty, its own wickedness
,
 and
 its own wrath.


---

**¶11:**


This
 ruling evil exce
eds all the
 other governing
 fals
ities that
 exist

 derivative

---

**¶12:**


The
 external
 form of the
 ruling love
 of obsc
uring falsity has

 sem
blance of good — for
 the
 appearance
 of good
 is the body of all
 the powers belonging
 to the state
 of confused
 and
 dark
ening
 thought

 the works produced
 from

 eng
ender a craving for still

**¶13:**


In contrast, the ruling love of
 the state of self
-love bears
 the form
 of the
 l
ust
 for
 dominion —

ections. Perv
erted natural good is its

 And
 the
 external
 form
 of all
 the governing
 powers
 belonging
 to self
-love is likewise
 a
 corruption
 of natural good.
 Their works
 produce aversion to all

 in

 manifest
ation.

---

**¶
14:**

Again, the ruling love
 of the state of v
ain reasoning and
 self
-derived
 intelligence bears
 the form of the pride of one
's own thought
. Hardened natural truth is its
 external form. And the form
 of all who
 belong to this state is likewise
 a
 hard
ening of truth
 into
 mere
 argument
.
 Their works produce divisive, cutting disp
utation in
 every manifest
ation.

---

**¶
15:**

For its
 part, the ruling love of the state
 of fals
ified truth bears the form of merely
 sens
ual knowledge.
 Its external form has
 the semblance of genuine
 truth.
 And all
 the other
 governing powers belonging to this state likewise
 wear
 the appearance
 of truth. The
 works they
 produce carry
 the seductive delight of pl
ausible
 fals
ity —
 the sweetness that
 
imitates truth
 in

ation.

---

**¶
16:**

Again, the ruling love
 of the state of 
utter spiritual darkness is
 the
 fals
ification
 of truth in

 most complete

est and
 bas
est falsity.
 All
 the other governing powers belonging to this deep
est darkness

 of the
 densest falsity. And
 the works they produce yield
 nothing
 but interior
 anguish and spiritual
 b
itterness.
 Furthermore

ating spirit that reigns within

 day

esy from

-intelligence

ations;
 through

erfeit signs
,
 of
 every

; through those who are possessed by persu
asive fals
ities
;

acles,

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Five storehouses have arisen since the beginning in the land of darkness! The five elements poured out of them. Also, from the five elements were fashioned the five trees! Again, from the five trees were fashioned the five genera of creatures in each world, male and female. And the five worlds themselves have five kings therein, and five spirits, five bodies, five tastes; in each world, they not resembling one another!

The King of the world of Smoke [is the chief of all the rulers, the one] who came up from the depth of darkness; this is he who is the head of all wickedness, and all malignity. The beginning of the spread of the war occured through him; all the battles, fights, quarrelling, dangers, destructions, fights, wrestling-contests! That is the one who first made arise danger and war, with his worlds and his powers. Afterwards, also, he waged war with the light. He pitched a battle with the exalted kingdom.

Now, regarding the King of Darkness, there are five shapes on him! His head is lion-faced; his hands and feet are demon- and devil-faced; his shoulders are eagle-faced; while his belly is dragon-faced; his tail is fish-faced. These five shapes, the marks of his five worlds, exist on the King of the realms of Darkness!

Now, there are five other properties in him. The first is his darkness. The second is his putridity. The third is his ugliness. The fourth is his bitterness, his own soul. The fifth is his burning, which burns like an iron () as if poured out from fire.

[There are] also three others in him! The first, that his body is hard and very tough, even as she has formed him [to be] cruel-hearted; namely Matter, who is the thought of death, [the o]ne who sculpted him from the nature of the land of darkness. This is the manner of the body of the ruler of Smoke. He is harder than every iron, copper and steel and lead; as there is no cleaver at all, nor any iron implement, can [pierce] him and cut him. For Matter, his fashioner, has formed him [to be exceedingly] strong and hard.

The third, that the King of the realms of Darkness knows the converse and language of his five worlds. He understands every thing he hears from their mouths, as they address one another; each one of them in his language. [Every] design they will consider against him, every snare they debate with one another to bring upon him, he knows them! He can also understand the gesturing they signal between one another. Yet, his powers and his rulers, who are subject to him, can not understand his wordy converse. While all these things are unveiled to him; still, their heart is not manifested to him. He knows not their mind nor their thought; he can not ponder their beginning and their end. Rather, he only knows and apprehends what is before his eyes.

Also, another different thing is found in the King of the realms of Darkness! For when it pleases him to move, he spreads all his limbs out and walks. When it comes to mind, he with[d]raws his limbs and takes them in, and is rolled (?) to his companions; and he falls to the ground like a grape and a great iron ball! He terrifies by his cry, he is frightful. He frightens his powers with his sound; because when he speaks, being like thunder in the clouds, he resembles the [crashing] of the rocks [that fall from the mountains.] When he cries out and [roars] and calls [out] over his powers, they shall tremble and to[tter a]nd fall under foot; even as some birds would be [frightened by] the bird [of prey,] and they fall down to the earth. Still, this thing only: he knows not what is far from him, he sees not who is at a distance, nor does he hear him. Rather, whoever is before his face he sees, hearing him and knowing him.

These signs and these evil marks are found in the chief of the demons and fiends, the King of all the mountains of Darkness [; this is the one] to [whom] the land of darkness has given birth, begotten in its cruelty, in its wickedness and its wrath [and its malice.]
[He surpasses in wickedness and in might] more than all his fellow rulers, who are in all his worlds.
Gold is the body of the King of the realms of Darkness. The body of all the powers who belong to the world of Smoke is gold. And also, the taste of its fruits is salty.

In contrast, the King of the worlds of Fire is lion-faced, the foremost of all the beasts. Copper is his body. Again, the body of all the rulers who belong to Fire is copper. Their taste is the sour taste that is in every form.
Again, the King of the worlds of Wind is eagle-face. His body is iron. Also, the body of all they who belong to the Wind is iron. Their taste is the sharp taste that is in every form.

For his part, the King of the world of Water is fish-face. His body is silver. All the other rulers who belong to Water, silver is their body. Also, the taste of their fruit is the sweetness of water, the sweet taste that is in every (form).

Again, [the Kin]g of the world of Darkness is a dragon. His [body is lead] and tin. All the other rulers [who belong to the world of] Darkness, their body is lead and tin. And also, the taste of their fruits is bitterness. Again, the spirit who reigns in them is the spirit who speaks till today in the soothsayers, giving oracles; in the givers of portents, every type; in they who are possessed; and the other spirits that give oracles, every type.
